listing.name: Stellar Networks
listing.summary: Adds six interactive intel boards for contacts, commodities, exploration, market queries, market viewing, and storage.
listing.aiSummary: Adds six interactive intel boards for contacts, commodities, exploration, market queries, market viewing, and storage.

description:
Stellar Networks
Information at your fingertips.

Stellar Networks is a quality-of-life oriented mod. It adds six new interactive intel boards: Contacts, Commodity, Exploration, Market Queries (space Google) and Viewer, and Storage. It is a continuation of my three separate 0.9.1a mods - Stellar Logistics, Hyperspace Network, and Galactic Markets.

Contacts board presents a filterable (by priority, by type) list of all your active contacts. Using the board, you can quickly navigate to see each contact's intel details, or directly call the person. All items and ships acquired during the call will be deposited to the Storage of the respective market.

Images

Commodity board (formerly Galactic Markets) is used to display buying and selling prices among all known markets. It also hosts a Profit tab which can be used to find viable trade routes. Profit tab filters by most profitable routes in descending order and displays routes where:

profit margin is at least 10000 credits, and
trade volume is at least 100 items.

It also highlights rows when buy and sell markets are in the same system and caps results to first 50.
The above defaults are all configurable in LunaLib settings.

Images

Exploration mini-board is a small intel based filter tool to quickly show or hide selected intel found in %u201CExploration%u201D tab. Works on intel added by CaptainsLog (will show additional filters).

Market query board (formerly Hyperspace Network) manages market searches. These can be either staff search (e.g. freelance administrator, steady officer, aggressive mercenary), item search (e.g. specific mod-spec or weapon), or ship search (e.g. pristine frigate, d-modded carrier).

Images

Market Viewer board lets you select a market and preview content of all its legal submarkets.

Images

By default, both Market boards work with Open and Military Markets only. To enable support for Black or Custom Markets, change settings via LunaLib.

Storage board (formerly Stellar Logistics) displays all cargo and ships stored among all Storages. It allows displaying a unified view to quickly check what is available, and per-location view to find out where.

aiDescription: Provides a unified interface for managing contacts, trade routes, market searches, and stored cargo. Includes filterable lists for active contacts, commodity prices with profit route analysis, exploration intel filters, staff/item/ship market queries, submarket previews, and cross-market storage views.
saveCompatibilityText: This mod is safe to add to an existing save.
removalCompatibilityText:
This mod can be removed from an existing save:
 Prior to 3.1.0 edit `stelnet.json` file and set "uninstallMod" to true. From 3.1.0 and onwards use LunaLib.
 Load your save, save the game, and quit it. From 2.5.0 you will get a message confirming successful uninstallation.
 Disable the mod and verify you can load the game.
 You can either continue like this, or update the mod.
